statement: Under the frozen H2 scope-only exploratory discovery attempt 20261108T095410-f87b41e0ef, 17 cells (10 BBH and 7 MMLU) among 57 support- and inference-eligible cells met the fixed descriptive sensitivity rule; all 84 declared cells were retained. These 30% question clusters had already been inspected for H1. This is exploratory reuse, not independent confirmation, a replication of H1, or evidence about latent reasoning. The separately frozen confirmation criterion was assessed on unused questions.
scope: Exploratory descriptive summary of the pinned historical release, equal-question weights, scope-only H2 context.
limitations: Discovery reuses H1-inspected questions; no independent confirmation or new-model replication.
Simultaneous bootstrap families are approximate and separate by endpoint and split.
Released judge annotation, not latent faithfulness; matching changes population.
assessment_basis: Independently reconstructed the H2 exploratory split: 2,858 questions, 2,820 clusters, 77,664 per-question rows, all 84 estimates and support counts, all 5,000 global bootstrap replicas and all three interval families (maximum error 4.44e-16). Verified 17 material cells, comprising 10 BBH and 7 MMLU comparisons among 57 eligible cells. This explicitly reuses H1 discovery; confirmation was assessed separately on previously unused questions.
reviewer_independence: Distinct child agent. Authored none of the evaluated source note, plans, primary implementation, results, proposal statement or manuscript. Authored only independent checks and reviews. This is local team review, not external peer review.
